title: Double Drip Cherry Bakewell Nic Salts E Liquid 10ml
description: A medley of ripe mixed berries and a subtle undertone of cooling menthol. This Nic Salt vape is perhaps the most perfect all day vape. Nicotine Salt E Liquids , often referred to as nic salts , are designed to mimic the strength and sensation of the nicotine found in a traditional tobacco cigarette. Although they are primarily intended for use with Pod Vape Kits , nic salts can in fact be used with any Vape Tank with a high resistance coil. Nic salts with a low nicotine strength can even be used in powerful E Cigarette Kits (high VG), offering a combination of intense flavour and a satisfying throat hit. Nicotine salts also deliver nicotine to the blood stream far quicker than standard nicotine-containing vape juice, providing immediate relief from pesky cravings.
